title: 'Axelrod', ONI Nimitz investigator, studying Skinwalker Ranch

tellings.quote: they have this guy, I think his name is Axelrod, he's a pseudonym and he sort of studies the phenomena, but he was the chief um Office of Naval Intelligence investigator on the Nimitz case in 2004 and he's, you know, showing up at Skinwalker Ranch and studying this stuff.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a man who goes by the made-up name Axelrod was the chief investigator for the Office of Naval Intelligence, the US Navy's intelligence service, on the Nimitz case. That is a 2004 episode in which Navy crews from the aircraft carrier USS Nimitz reported an unexplained object. Michels says this same man now shows up at Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange happenings, to study them, which would mean someone from the Navy's own investigation has carried that work onto the ranch.
